title: Computational design of siRNAs targeting SIRT7 in gynaecological cancers with cell-penetrating peptide-based delivery assessment.
one_liner_zh: 该研究用计算工具设计靶向SIRT7的siRNA并进行对接/模拟评估，虽涉及分子对接和模拟，但核心对象是siRNA而非蛋白质结构，且方法为常规工具应用，与蛋白质结构计算课题关联较弱。
abstract: SIRT7 is a multifunctional epigenetic regulator and is significantly overexpressed in three major gynaecological cancers i.e., ovarian, cervical, and endometrial cancers, contributing to the proliferation and progression of tumors. This study focused on computationally designing and evaluating small interfering RNAs (siRNAs) as promising therapeutic candidates targeting SIRT7. In silico expression analysis has confirmed overexpression of SIRT7 in tumor tissues as compared to normal samples. siRNAs (S1-S6) were designed using siDirect and OligoWalk, which were screened for specificity using BLASTn. GC content and secondary structure prediction were done using OligoCalc and MaxExpect which eliminated four siRNA candidates (S2-S5) due to unfavourable internal loops and hairpin structures. Candidate siRNAs and mRNA thermodynamic stability were predicted using DuplexFold webserver. Molecular docking and simulation studies revealed interactions of siRNA candidates with human Argonaute 2 (Ago2) protein, maintaining strong post-simulation hydrogen bonds and salt bridges. Both S1 and S6 showed stable interactions with key domains (MID, PAZ and PIWI) of Ago2 protein, suggesting favourable structural compatibility with RNA induced silencing complex (RISC). S1 and S6 emerge as promising siRNA candidates for targeting SIRT7. Virtual screening with cationic cell penetrating peptides (CPPs) demonstrated stable CPP-siRNA complexes, suggesting suitability of RVG-9DR and H8R15 as potential delivery agents of S1 and S6. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive computational framework for designing and evaluating siRNAs targeting SIRT7, although further experimental studies are required to validate their therapeutic potential.
abstract_zh: SIRT7是一种多功能表观遗传调控因子，在三种主要妇科癌症（即卵巢癌、宫颈癌和子宫内膜癌）中显著过表达，促进肿瘤的增殖和进展。本研究聚焦于通过计算设计并评估靶向SIRT7的小干扰RNA（siRNAs）作为有前景的治疗候选分子。计算机表达分析已证实，与正常样本相比，肿瘤组织中SIRT7过表达。使用siDirect和OligoWalk设计了siRNAs（S1-S6），并通过BLASTn筛选其特异性。利用OligoCalc和MaxExpect进行GC含量和二级结构预测，由于不利的内部环和发夹结构，排除了四个siRNA候选分子（S2-S5）。使用DuplexFold网络服务器预测候选siRNA与mRNA的热力学稳定性。分子对接和模拟研究揭示了siRNA候选分子与人Argonaute 2（Ago2）蛋白的相互作用，在模拟后维持了强氢键和盐桥。S1和S6均与Ago2蛋白的关键结构域（MID、PAZ和PIWI）表现出稳定相互作用，表明与RNA诱导沉默复合体（RISC）具有良好的结构兼容性。S1和S6成为靶向SIRT7的有前景的siRNA候选分子。与阳离子细胞穿透肽（CPPs）的虚拟筛选展示了稳定的CPP-siRNA复合物，表明RVG-9DR和H8R15作为S1和S6潜在递送载体的适用性。总体而言，本研究为设计和评估靶向SIRT7的siRNAs提供了一个全面的计算框架，尽管仍需进一步的实验研究来验证其治疗潜力。
